newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean 3-yr yields end up as banks cut buying.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean 3-yr yields end up as banks cut buying.

text.p: Yields on three-year corporates closed higher on Wednesday as banks and institutions reduced investment on long-term bonds, brokers said.
Three-month CD yields closed unchanged in weak trading.
The overnight call rates fell as liquidity with banks remained high due to falling demand for long-term bonds.
* 3-yr corporates end at 12.57 pct from 12.52 on Tuesday
